description: This file defines a Kotlin interface for handling user interactions with a tags recycler view, including item clicks, long clicks, and checkbox interactions.

classes.name: TagsRecyclerListener
classes.description: An interface specifying callback methods for tag item interactions in a RecyclerView.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Callback triggered when a tag item at a specific position is clicked.

methods.name: onLongClick
methods.description: Callback triggered when a tag item is long-clicked; returns a boolean indicating event consumption.

methods.name: checkTagOnClick
methods.description: Callback triggered when a checkbox associated with a tag is clicked; returns a boolean indicating event handling.
